stent implantation results not only in more intense and prolonged MMP expression, but also in more active MMPs than balloon angioplasties, which may contribute to the higher incidence of stent restenosis than that of balloon restenosis.

the differential regulation of MMPs and MMP inhibitors (TIMP) after ST and BA in hypercholesterolemiac rabbits.
